differences.before: Emil read Blaise’s written account of his sight of the cut and its limits. He required “agreed to the replacement” to be corrected to “asked him to keep the return.” He permitted Blaise to show the checked account to both women. They had not yet received it.
differences.after: Emil read Blaise’s written account of his sight of the cut, its limits and his request to keep the return while knowing Dora wanted to leave. He added that he had neither agreed to a replacement nor known there would be one. He permitted Blaise to show the checked account to both women. They had not yet received it.
